tools.description: Evaluate Clojure in this session's SCI worker and return its value: a string as plain text, any other value as EDN. Definitions persist across calls in the same session. A result larger than about 60 KB comes back as a preview with a truncation note, and the worker keeps running. Its full value is bound to full-result, which paging does not change; read the rest with (page full-result offset n). Clojure reader syntax works: #"\d+" (no double escaping), #(...), 'x, @x and #'v. #= and tagged literals such as #inst are refused. clojure.string and String methods such as (.indexOf s "x") work, as does Integer/parseInt; Long, Math and Character classes do not. read-string, eval, slurp, spit and printing (println, pr-str) are denied; build text with str and clojure.string.
